New to Speed
This was the first time I ever did speed. I have been smoking grass for a few years, and friends had told me about it. This all started the morning of December 13. I go to highschool. So a friend of mine who has a percription sold me 2 pills for 2 bucks apiece early in the morning, I gave one pill to a friend of mine for a xmas present and i saved the other one, planing to take it during lunch, after all my finals were done. I waited all day, anxious to try my new found drug. In fourth period I couldn't wait anymore and popped the pill about 10 minutes before lunch. Instantly I had a good feeling, this was gonna be good. I went down to lunch, and sat with my friend. He said his had already worn off, (he took it at 730 in the morning and it was 1145). I was already feeling the effects. Hyper, restless hands, talking fast. It was rather pleasant, except for the urge to move my body. I feel if i had had my guitar I would have been able to play rather fast. As the day kept on, the effects continued. The hyper-ness subsided to my normal self, and I was left with a nice euphoric feeling. This lasted for the rest of the day, and as I right this experience I am still feeling pretty good. Just a general optimistic feeling. I enjoy this drug and plan to use it again, but I see how I could develop a habit.
I plan to use a stronger does if I need the stimulant effects, but I'm a big guy. A low dose like the one I took is good for mild stimulation, like smoking a cigarette for one who doesn't do it often. It also leaves a nice euphoric feeling after the stimulant has worn off.
